tei:div.tei:p: gnam chos 'od chog 'don zin bzhugs so/ 598) rgyal kun gsung gi dbang phyug che// 'od mtshan stong 'bar lhag pa'i lha// bde chen 'khor lor rtag bzhugs nas// byang chub bar du rjes 'dzin mdzod/ gang du bya ba'i gzhir rgyu rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi padma 'dab brgyad khar mañdzi'i steng bum pa bcud ldan mgul chings dmar pos brgyan pa/ kha rgyan gseb tu 'od dpag med pa'i snang brnyan gzugs/ phyag mtshan lhung bzed/ tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ mda' dar/ rgyab tu zhi gtor zlum po 'khor gnyis mtheb skyu grangs med kyis bskor ba/ g.yon phyogs lta bur zhing skyong lcam dral gtor 599) ma/ mdun phyogs su sman raka gtor gsum/ de'i byang shar du mtshams 'dzin me tog steng du chu/ shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs bsil/ lhor me tog lho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/ gzhan yang tshogs kyi yo byad/ las bum rnams kyang nye bar bsag sgrub pa po rnams kyi mdun du nang mchod/ rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/ nas bzed/ rol mo'i rigs rnams kyang bsags la/ thog mar/ hrīḥsngon gyi bskal pa'i= 600) sna drangs/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ zhes pa'i rjes su rnying sngon nas byung ba'i/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du a las byung ba'i khro mo dbyings phyug ma zhu ba'i bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ sarba dra byaṃ shwa dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ rnam bdag chos dbyings ngang nyid las// rang byung mchod pa'i phung po ni// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bu// dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rdor sems rgyun khyer nang gi mchod brlab lta bu bsdus pa zhig dang*/ tshul khrims dri ldan= gyis spos phyung bya/ e ma ho/ kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje 'chang chen po// rdzogs chen ston pa bcu gnyis rdor sems sogs// rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs// gdod ma'i gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis

601) rlobs// dga' rab rdo rje shrī seng ha dang: /rgya gar rig 'dzin brgyad dang mkha' spyod kyi// rig 'dzin lnga dang gu ru pad ma 'byung*// rig 'dzin brda brgyud kun la gsol ba 'debs// 'ja' lus 'chi med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// rje 'bangs nyer lnga gter ston brgya rtsa sogs// chos bdag gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so chos nyid zad phyin shog /gu ru zhi drag bka' dgongs phur gsum sogs// phag khros seng gsum zhi khro rab 'byams sogs// yi dam lha tshogs kun la gsol ba 'debs// mchog thun dngos grub myur thob byin gyis rlobs// ma ning sde lnga 'bar ma seng gdong ma// dzam la rigs lnga nor rgyun mched lnga sogs// chos skyong gter bdag rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ci bsam thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ 602) /de ltar bdag gis gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// tshe dang sgrub pa ma lus mthar phyin nas// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// le tshan gong ma dang*/ badzra sa ma dzaḥ skyabs yul gsal/ na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa= skyabs sems la lan gsum/ rdo rje slob dpon= / sogs yan lag brgyad pa lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su gsal// thugs ka'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las// phyogs skyong gzhi bdag 'byung po'i tshogs// spyan drangs mdun du 'khod par gyur/ 'dir dkar gtor gtang yang 'gal ba med/ rin chen snod du gtor ma ni// bdud rtsir gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐// gnyug gnas glo bur lhags pa yi// gnas bdag gzhi bdag 'byung po'i tshogs// 'dir 'dus mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes/ 603) /gnas 'dir gsang sngags sgrub pa la// ru nga phrag dog ma byed par// dkar phyogs sdong grogs mthun rkyen sgrubs// nag phyogs bgegs rigs gzhan du dengs// gal te mi nyan 'tshe byed na// ye shes khro bos brlag par 'gyur// de bas bsgo ba'i bka' la nyon// oṃ sarba lo ka pā la ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi// sarba bignan=

gatstshaḥ 'i bar dang*/ suṃ bha ni sa bgegs bskrad/ sku las 'od dpag med pa'i sku che phra// gsung las sngags phreng hrīḥyig dmar po dang*// thugs las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa/ kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du byon// bdag mdun rnams la sib sib thim par gyur/ ces byin 'bebs/ ka dag klong nas= sogs/ mchod brlabs nas/ de nas lha bskyed/ me tog chu skyes= nas gzhung 'gros la/ sman mchod gsham du/ bde ldan zhing mgon khyab bdag chos 604)kyi sku// gru 'dzin bdag po 'phags mchog longs spyod rdzogs// rnga yab gling pa mtsho skyes sprul sku la// sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol// shes rab pha rol phyin yum mtsho rgyal lcam// mchog thun grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal seng ge /zab gter sgo 'byed mi 'gyur rdo rje la// sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol// bka' babs lung bstan las can chos kyi bdag /dus gsum mkhas grub rim par byon rnams dang*// rtsa brgyud bla ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha// sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ hūm̐: bdag gi skyabs gnas= sogs sbrel/ bstod pa/ bshags pa/ gsol 'debs/ zur gsal dzapra dmigs bcas rtsa sngags rgyas bsdus rnams stong rtsa grub nges/ 'dir spro na bum bzlas spyi 605) 'gro la/ bum pa rang byung gi gzhal yas khang du lha rnams dwangs pa'i mtsho la gza' skar shar ba bzhin skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ rang srog sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la// 'khril te bum pa'i lha tshogs thugs kar zhugs// de dag sku las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun// babs pas bum chur dbyer med ro gcig gyur// a mi dhe wa brgya tsam bzlas/ las sbyor dmigs pa rdor sems ltar/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang thugs rje'i 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas/ ngan song rnams sbyangs/

dmigs yul gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing du sgral bar gyur/ gzungs ring brgya'am nyer gcig bsdu na/ mdun bskyed bum bskyed sogs bum dzapra dang*/ las sbyor bsnyain pa bzlas dmigs bcas gzungs ring 606) rgya'am/ nyer gcig bdun/ gsum/ gson chog yin na tshe sgrub sbrel/ gshin chog la mi dgos/ 'grub par gyur cig dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying*/ badzra arghaṃ= sogs dang tshig bzhis bstod/ las bum sgrub pa ni/ oṃ swa bha wa= las bum khro rgyal rta mgrin ni: dmar po g.yas pas thod dbyug la: g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pa'o: 'dir gshegs pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: khro chen rta mgrin rgyal po yis: sprul pa'i 'od zer dgra bgegs 'dul: dngos grub bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil: bgegs kyi sbyor ba rgyun chod cig: oṃ hya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: lha 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chur gyur/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya oṃ/ āḥbadzra 607)sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swa badzra sa ma ya swa/ hā badzra sa ma ya hā/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnam gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las rmad po che// de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas// phyag rgya chen por bdag sbyor cig oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya st+wam̐/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya ho/ sogs rig pa'i me tog dor ba rdor sems ltar ro/ mdun bum gnas lnga nas 'phros thig le ni// dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gu bkrag mdangs can// oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hā yis mtshan pa rnams// rang gi gnas lngar thim pas dngos grub thob/ rtsa sngags mthar kā ya sogs sbyar ba'i mthar/ oṃ/ rdo rje'i ye shes thob byed pa'i// de bzhin 608) gshegs pa thams cad kyi// snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir// bdag gi slob ma 'jug par 'tshal/

sogs gnang ba zhu ba 'di nam yang chad mi nyan/ de nas gshin chog la bsang sbyang*/ dmigs rten bskyed 'gugs nas 'don/ gson chog la/ bhrum̐ las rin chen= sogs bgegs gtor nas 'don/ spro na/ e ma ho:rdzogs pa'i= mthar/ sa gzhi spos tshus= sogs bde chen zhing dbang ltar/ kye: bla ma 'od dpag med mgon dang: spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob: sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med la: gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur stsol: zhes gsol 'debs lan gsum/ lo rgyus dang tshig lhug rnams mi dgos/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog: lan gsum/ me tog chu skyes= sogs slob ma lha bskyed/ byin 'bebs/ tiṣṭha badzra/ bcas/ bum dbang / 609) hūm̐: 'di ni bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: bde ba can gyi zhing khams yin: khyod kyi mgo la bzhag pa yis: snang ba mtha' yas zhal mthong shog: oṃ āḥhrīḥswa hā: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: sku dbang*/ hūm̐: 'di ni bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis: bde chen zhing du skyes nas kyang: snang ba mtha' yas zhal mthong shog: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥpañtsa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gtor dbang*/ hūm̐: 'di ni bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyis bskor: khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis: bde chen zhing du skyes nas kyang: 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a mi dhe wa ā yu siddhi hūm̐ kā ya wākka tsitta 610)a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje/ hūm̐: 'di ni 'od dpag med mgon la: sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyis bskor: khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis: 'od dpag med mgon dbang thob nas: bde ba can du skye bar shog: oṃ hrīḥswa hā badzra dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lhung bzed/ hūm̐: 'di ni 'od dpag med mgon te: khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis:

bde chen zhing du skyes nas kyang: 'od dpag med pa'i zhal mthong shog: oṃ bhrum̐ swa hā: puṇye gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bcas tshigs bcad rkyang pas/ bde chen zhing du= sogs bkra shis brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar= de dag thams cad= maṇḍal/ deng nas brtsams te= sogs/ yid mthun snod= sogs zas bsngo/ lam bstan bcas/ me sbar do nub bar bskyur/ bzang spyod smon lam tshar gcig hūm̐ hrīḥ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba= shis brjod/ gson chog la/ tshe 'das la/ skal ldan= zhes brjod/ 611) dbang zin mthar/ zla ba'i steng du me dpung= zhes sbyar nas/ bzang spyod 'don/ slar cho ga grangs gsog lugs/ na mo:dkon mchog gsum= nas gzhung 'gros sab kha med pa'i bsnyen pa rgyas bsdus stong rtsa/ bum bzlas gzungs ring tshar gsum/ mchod bstod bcas/ de 'dra ba skyabs sems nas bsnyen bstod yan tshar gsum/ rjes dbang len gnang ba zhu nas/ byang chog rten bskyed nas gzhung rgyug zas bsngo'i 'go bar/ bkra shis tshig bzhi dang*/ yang khrus nas/ hūm̐: bum pa 'di ni= zhes pa nas/ dbang yan bsag tshar gsum pa'i dbang mthar/ zas bsngo lam bstan bcas/ bzang spyod tshar gsum/ de ltar tshar gsum re dang*/ byang chog tshar gsum re sbrags mas tshar du 'don dgos kyang btang nas/ tshar rjes ma bsnyen bstod zin nas/ gtor bsngos dang*/ zhing skyong gtor chog nag 'gros btang*/ 'di mtshams na raka skong bshags mar me'i smon lam yan dang*/ tshogs bsgrigs nas byin rlabs 612) spyan 'dren/ tshogs mchod mthar bskang ba/ de mthar lhag ma bcas rnga rol rgyas pa gtang*/ slar yang tshogs byin rlabs nas lhag ma yan cho ga tshar du gtong gi grangs tshogs skong bsags nas/ tshar rjes ma'i bskang ba'i rjes/ tshogs rdzas 'dod yon= ci nus bsag de nas rig pa'i me tog dor/ gnang ba zhus nas/ byang chog gtang*/ dbang rgyas pa da nangs ltar bskur/ gson chog yin na dbang gi ye shes dbab bstim rjes/ tshe 'gugs dang*/

bum gtor phyag mtshan rnams rjes/ tshe chang tshe ril bcas sbyin/ bkra shis/ dam tshig khas blangs/ gtang rag maṇḍal/ lus dbul/ zas gtad phyin drug zas bsngo'i tshigs bcad rnams gtang*/ me sbar/ lam bstan bcas kyis byang bu bzhu/ byang tshwa gdab pa rdor sems sbyin sreg mthar yod pa'am/ chab gtor ma'i/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dzña na badzra swa bha wa atma ko3 haṃ/ lan gsum/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i 613)thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas snang srid thams cad la phog pas dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ dag pa ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od kyi rnam par gyur/ sku phor phyogs thams cad du g.yugs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ ci nus bzlas rjes/ phyi mchod rten gyi rnam pa la nang thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa de 'dra ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pas stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams gang bar gyur/ ye dharma= sogs/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swa hā/ kye/ phrin las rnam dag sku gsung thugs// yon tan ma lus rgya che ba// bzhengs pa rnams la byin gyis rlobs// rten mchog 'gyur pa'i bkra shis shog /rten mchog 'di bzhengs dge ba yis/ 614) /pha ma 'gro ba ma lus pa// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang de// myur ba nyid du thob gyur cig mi 'gyur lhun po= dang*/ bzang spyod gtsos smon lam gang shes gdab/ de nas/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol/ lta bus tshogs drang*/ bsam lhun/ lhag ma gtang*/ rtsa rgyud zhing skyong sngon tshar med na 'dir gtang*/ bskul/ chad bstan/ bro mnan/ rjes chog mchod bstod/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi dngos grub blang*/ nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis rnams chog bsgrigs su gsal bar ltar bya'o// 'dir 'bad dge bas mtha' yas 'gro// bde chen zhing du skyes nas kyang*// tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa ni// rnam kun mkhyen nyid thob gyur cig
ces pa'ang dbang rgyal bzhed ngor dpal chen 'dus bas so// dge'o//
